name: @velocms/mcp

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Lists blog posts for the authenticated tenant, paginated (default 20/page, max 100). Optionally filter by status (draft or published). Requires the posts:read API key scope.

status.description: Filter by post status (draft or published).

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetches a single post by its PocketBase record ID, including content_html/content_json and SEO fields. Requires the posts:read scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Creates a new blog post. Defaults to status=draft — pass status=published to publish immediately (stamps published_at automatically), or create as a draft and call publish_post once you're ready. Requires the posts:write scope.

contentJson.description: TipTap ProseMirror JSON document (arbitrary structure). Prefer contentHtml unless you specifically need to write a ProseMirror document.

status.description: draft (default) or published. Publishing here stamps published_at automatically — or create as draft and call publish_post later.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Partially updates an existing post — only the fields you pass are changed. Requires at least one field besides id. Requires the posts:write scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post to update.

status.description: draft or published. Transitioning draft -> published stamps published_at automatically. Prefer publish_post/unpublish_post for a status-only change.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Permanently deletes a post by ID. Requires the posts:write scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post to delete.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Sets a post's status to published (stamps published_at). Shorthand for update_post({ status: 'published' }). Requires the posts:write scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post to publish.

tools.name: unpublish_post
tools.description: Sets a post's status back to draft, taking it off the public site. Shorthand for update_post({ status: 'draft' }). Requires the posts:write scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post to unpublish.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: Lists items in the media library, paginated. Optionally filter by MIME type prefix (e.g. 'image'). Requires the media:read scope.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Uploads a file to the media library from either a public http(s) url or base64 data (with filename + mime_type), plus optional alt text. Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, MP4, WebM (no SVG). Max 10 MB, or 500 MB for video. Returns the new media item including its public url. Requires the media:write scope.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to fetch and upload. Provide this OR data, not both.

data.description: Base64-encoded file bytes (no data: prefix). Requires filename and mime_type. Provide this OR url, not both.

filename.description: File name, e.g. 'hero.png'. Required with data; optional with url.

mime_type.description: MIME type. Required with data; with url it overrides the response Content-Type. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, application/pdf, video/mp4, video/webm.

alt.description: Alt text for images, max 1000 chars.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Lists comments, paginated. Optionally filter to a specific post (postId) and/or by moderation status (approved, pending, spam). Requires the comments:read scope.

postId.description: Filter to comments on a specific post.

tools.name: moderate_comment
tools.description: Sets a comment's moderation status (approved, pending, or spam). Requires the comments:moderate scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the comment to moderate.

status.description: Moderation status to apply: approved, pending, or spam.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: Lists reader/subscriber records, paginated. Email local parts are masked by the API (e.g. u***@example.com). Optionally filter by tier (free or paid). Requires the members:read scope.

tier.description: Filter by subscription tier (free or paid).

tools.name: get_site_settings
tools.description: Fetches the tenant's site configuration (name, description, logo, favicon, members/comments enabled flags). Encrypted fields (Stripe keys, AI API key) are always excluded by the API. Requires the site-settings:read scope.
